page_note: Heavily damaged page (79.4% lacunae) presenting a cosmological parable that culminates in the Living Spirit/First Man drama. The parable of the noble son and the judge sent by the king is then explicitly mapped onto the cosmic event: 'so also is this: the Living Spirit is likened to him whom they sent forth from the King of the Lights' — the judgment against the King of Darkness for the violence done to the First Man, and against the archons who transgressed. This is core substrate cosmogonic narrative throughout: King of the Lights, First Man, Living Spirit, King of Darkness, archons, Sin, binding in heaven and earth. The single ecclesial flag (i=13, ϣⲃ̄ⲙⲩⲥⲧⲏⲣⲓⲟⲛ 'fellow-mysteries') is in heavy damage and reads in context as fellow members of the judicial parable body, not as ritual mystery institution. Editorial fatigue score is negative (-0.88), confirming no late drift.
